customers/create-customer-onboarding.rul: As admin, call customerProfiles/createUnclaimed with only the essentials (name, phone, branch) — Quick add mode.
Read the created control-panel user row: assert role is null and the onboarding fields (id_passport_no, emergency_contact_name) are null — the customer must self-complete later.
Teardown: members/remove (both DBs) + SQL delete of auth rows.
As admin, call createUnclaimed with the full onboarding profile (IC, address type, street/city/state/country/postal, DOB, emergency contact) — Full details mode.
Read the created user row: assert role='user' (registration complete) and every profile field persisted with the submitted values.
As admin, call createUnclaimed with SOME but not all onboarding fields (IC + street, no emergency contact).
Assert role stays null (not completed) while the supplied field (id_passport_no) is still stored — the role flip is strictly all-or-nothing.
